response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced Staff/Senior Software Engineer with strong distributed systems and diverse programming expertise, but he lacks the executive leadership experience required for a CTO role. He does not have a track record of scaling engineering organizations from 10 to 30+ people, nor does he possess the deep, production-level multi-agent AI and algorithmic fintech architecture experience mandated by the job description.
strengths: Strong backend and distributed systems expertise, including experience with high-throughput microservices handling millions of requests per second.
Recent hands-on experience with AI-agent infrastructure and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tooling.
Some relevant fintech exposure gained during his time working on investment practices at RIDE Capital.
concerns: Lacks executive engineering leadership experience and has no demonstrated history of scaling teams from 10 to 30+ engineers.
No evidence of architecting production-grade, multi-agent AI systems for complex financial or regulated environments.
Missing experience in managing outsourced engineering teams, establishing governance frameworks, and communicating technical roadmaps at the board level.
